records.provenance_summary: Replit's customer story says GenAIPI was built in days with Replit Agent and maps the product to genaipi.org.
Replit's customer story lists the SaaStr.ai website ecosystem among Jason Lemkin's Replit production applications.
The creator states that ClearScribe AI was built end-to-end with Replit Agent 3 and links clearscribehq.com as the live website.
The creator's dated account of building a second app with the Replit agent links realvsai.com as the deployment.
The creator documents the Replit-built podcast site, publishes the Agent's implementation briefing, and names podcast.thekamclub.com as the primary domain.
